Package com.cdarobotics.cdalib.tasks

Class Task

java.lang.Object
com.cdarobotics.cdalib.tasks.Task
Direct Known Subclasses:
BasicTask, DeadlineTask, DeferredTask, FollowPathTask, HoldPointTask, InstantTask, NullTask, ParallelTask, RaceTask, RepeatTask, SequentialTask, SleepTask, WaitUntilTask
public abstract class Task extends Object
Base type for all actions in the task framework. A task is initialized once via init(), then run() is polled every loop until it returns true to signal completion.

Tasks compose into larger behaviors through the fluent builders:

  • andThen(Task...) — run this task, then the given tasks in sequence
  • alongWith(Task...) — run this task in parallel with the given tasks; finishes when all finish
  • raceWith(Task...) — run this task in parallel with the given tasks; finishes when any one finishes
  • withDeadline(Task) — run this task until the given deadline task finishes
